snippets.snippet: S:/ shared/ Regional Planning/Forms/Steps Required for Building a Home.rev. 02 - 16 - 201 8 STEPS REQUIRED TO BUILD A HOME PROPERTY OWNER ’S NAME ________________________________ ____________________ TOWNSHIP _____________________________ The following steps are required prior to construction of a new home on an existing approved lot in Knox County. Township zoning requires minimum square footage for a house and setbacks for the road, side, and rear property lines. 18 out of 22 township s have zoning. Please contact the zoning inspector in the township to which you intend to build to apply for a zoning permit. If you intend to build on a new lot that has not received prior approval, please see the attached Minor Subdivision/Lot Split Administrative Review Application to start the approval process.
